# Gabriel Moreno Ribeiro

> Founder and researcher on a build year. Co-founder and CEO of HIBEEX.

Website: https://gabrielmr.com
Email: me@gabrielmr.com
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/gabriel-moreno-ribeiro
GitHub: https://github.com/gabriel-moreno-ribeiro
Last updated: September 2026

## Summary

Gabriel Moreno Ribeiro is an 18-year-old Brazilian founder and researcher on a build year. He is co-founder and CEO of HIBEEX, which builds backoffice AI for small and medium businesses: raw data in, decisions the owners can act on out. HIBEEX is one of 6 startups in the Canastra Ventures AI Residency, and Gabriel is among the youngest founders the program has picked.

He was admitted to the University of St Andrews with a Global Merit Scholarship and placed 1st at Insper for Computer Engineering. He chose a build year to go deeper on HIBEEX before starting university.

He cares about using technology to widen access to capital and education.

## Highlights

- **Co-founder and CEO of HIBEEX** (January 2026 to present): backoffice AI for small and medium businesses. One of 6 startups in the Canastra Ventures AI Residency. Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, AWS.
- **Fintech savings RCT**: designed and ran a randomized controlled trial with 208 public-school students on whether fintech apps change savings behavior, advised by Aaron Litvin, Ph.D. (Harvard). The treatment group saved 130% more.
- **Chemical kinetics research** with Prof. Juliano Bonacin, Ph.D.: reaction mechanisms modeled at 97% accuracy in a 59-page thesis.
- **39 olympiad medals** (19 gold, 2 international) across 49 academic olympiads. 1st of 10,000+ at IFT-UNESP. Gold at ONNEQ (top 0.675%). 1st at OBAQ (top 0.014%).
- **Projeto Candela**: founded a project that builds low-cost physics lab kits. 3,392 students in 28 public schools; physics failure rates went from 30% to 10%.
- **SAT 1510/1600**, top 1% in Brazil.
- **Fundação Estudar PREP scholar**: one of about 70 from 10,000+ applicants (0.7% acceptance).
- **Instituto Principia** (Escola de Talentos, 14 picked nationally): quantum mechanics, relativity, statistical physics.
- **Co-founder and CEO of GSAT Education** (2025 to 2026): EdTech for standardized test prep.
- **President of the Olympic Club at Colégio Militar**: 17 initiatives, participation up 47%, national olympiad results up 62%.
